partner.name: Eden Restaurant
partner.descriptionHtml:
Prepare to be captivated the moment you step into Eden Restaurant, a breathtaking glasshouse sanctuary nestled on Singapore's iconic Orchard Road. Sunlight streams through soaring glass roof, lush greenery envelops every corner, and the intoxicating aromas of modern Asian cuisine fill the air — setting the stage for a meal you won't forget.


Expect classics, but not as you know them. Expect premium ingredients, layered craftsmanship, and unexpected twists that turn every course into a reveal. From Corn-Fed “Chicken Rice” and Cantonese Honey Char Siew Iberico Pork Collar to Rendang Australian Wagyu Beef Cheeks and Chendol Crème Brûlée, each dish hints at something familiar — yet promises something entirely new.


Note: ALL points from Accor Live Limitless Loyalty programme can be utilized/earned in conjunction with payments via Kris+. All Accor Plus Explorer (paid membership) discounts and vouchers cannot be utilized in conjunction with Kris+ payments.
